published: Detection is relative to each observer and defaults to Observed.
Cover or concealment permits Hide but does not itself make a creature Hidden.
Sneak can improve detection only against observers for whom the creature started Hidden or Undetected.
tablePolicy: Visibility and physical attack paths sample footprint grid intersections.
One observer intersection seeing all target intersections is unobstructed.
Exactly one visible target intersection grants greater cover; more than one but fewer than half grants standard cover; zero blocks the path.

tests.regression: Observed remains unchanged by cover alone; Hide can produce Hidden; only a subsequent eligible Sneak can produce Undetected. Separate observer intersections never pool visibility.
